'''Colonial News Nets''' was a network of eighteen local news agencies that broadcast to most [[Sector/Legends|sectors]] throughout the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]]. Each network covered a number of systems,<ref name="J11">{{JournalCite|11|Galaxywide NewsNets}}</ref> and maintained offices on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Findris]].<ref name="CRO" /> Colonial News Nets was pro-[[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]], and supported law and order. However, the agency believed that the Empire should adhere to its own laws, which caused friction between the agency and Imperial [[Politics/Legends|political]] offices.<ref name="J11" /> Colonial News Nets staff included [[Pertaal Shenvehr]], an assistant features editor who was responsible for several features such as "[[Art Galaxy Roundup]]," "[[Personalities in the News]]," and "[[Ask Argothil Anything]]"; [[Fionna Flannis]], a [[Journalist/Legends|journalist]] who reported on social events, personalities and celebrities;<ref name="CRO" /> and [[Alandra Mipsy]], who covered the political and social scene on the planet [[Procopia/Legends|Procopia]].<ref name="LE">''[[Lords of the Expanse]]''</ref>
